comments.body:
Good catch!

We can make this more concise and more future proof if we just check for `_error` in the message_type:
```
        elif message_type and message_type.endswith("_error"):
            # Handle all error types
            error_msg = data.get("error", "Unknown error")
            await self.push_error(error_msg=f"ElevenLabs {message_type}: {error_msg}")
```

This would replace your proposal and the individual checks for `"error"`, `"auth_error"`, and `"quota_exceeded_error"`.
